query: What is Community as a Service?
direct_answer: Community as a Service is an outsourced operating model in which a specialist partner helps a company design, launch, operate, measure, and improve an owned community without requiring the company to build every community capability internally.
best_for: brands and companies building or operating owned communities
teams that need strategy and operating ownership to connect
not_for: teams seeking guaranteed member growth or revenue
organizations unwilling to define member value or operating ownership
